_comment: Destination Apparition: the press opens the selector of memorised points, and picking one begins an ANCHORED charge. serverCharge is true so the same key's release ends that charge — otherwise a jump started from a GUI would have no way to be let go of. Pressing again while a charge is in flight is a no-op, not a second selector. cooldownTicks 0 because ApparitionServerLogic owns the shared Apparition cooldown, charged only when a jump actually happens.
